rule: Sidecar corrections govern current use; imported and historical raw bytes are preserved.

corrections.obsolete_claim: Two banks described as strike/sustain parameter sets
corrections.correction: Banks are atomic double buffers. Writes go to the inactive bank; all sixteen words must be present before commit. No additional user timbre bank is implied.

corrections.obsolete_claim: Replace written bitmap with dirty flag for editing
corrections.correction: Do not remove the sixteen-word completeness guard. Draft/preview/apply/save/cancel require a separately reviewed state contract and tests; an inactive bank alone is not a complete editor.

corrections.obsolete_claim: No touchscreen; macro-only editor, sixteen-key PCF8575 plan
corrections.correction: J10 is retained. Macro-only scope and PCF8575/sixteen-key pin changes are proposals, not accepted limitations or interface changes.

corrections.obsolete_claim: d_m and d_k both increase decay duration
corrections.correction: For lvl - ((lvl*d_m)>>d_k), at fixed other inputs increasing d_m increases the decrement (faster decay); increasing d_k reduces it (slower), subject to integer quantization and minimum-decrement logic. Do not infer a complete musical model from this correction.

corrections.obsolete_claim: Q choices lack any direct human source; check marks or derisk recommendations constitute acceptance
corrections.correction: A direct human Q-combination question exists in this review. Later cuts/delays, test check marks and implementation advice are not blanket approval. Current music golden failure and untested product integration remain explicit.

corrections.obsolete_claim: Old small prototype quantities, CPL and procurement assumptions describe the current instrument
corrections.correction: Use the saved e098 227-component carrier identity. Current evidence records 215 SMT,12 TH,36 part numbers and47 connection issues/13nets. Final matched BOM/CPL, two-sided/TH assembly, screen/CTP, power/AUX and mechanical contracts remain open; no old total or deletion recommendation is adopted.

corrections.obsolete_claim: v2 or old embedded handoff fields are latest engineering source
corrections.correction: v2 and original handoff fields remain historical recovery. Current editable sources are the341-file engineering manifest and three current directories; live producer changes need separate review.

corrections.obsolete_claim: Historical private-only publication instructions still govern after user made repository public
corrections.correction: Current policy and workflow verify the target URL/name/immutable repository ID, not private visibility. Historical private observations remain time-scoped; public access does not authorize unrelated local disclosure.
